findings.evidence: Lines 427–436 assume `(hγ : Isometry γ)` and conclude the range alternatives; there is no reverse implication or quantified theorem from either Euclidean alternative to an isometry/geodesic.
findings.fix: Either weaken the theorem/doc claims to a one-way description, or add converse existence statements constructing an isometric parametrization for every unit-diameter intersection and every positive-radius circle satisfying `‖c‖² = R² + 1`.
findings.issue: `range_coe_eq_ball_inter_or_of_isometry` is described as saying geodesics are “exactly” the listed subsets, but its sole implication starts from `Isometry γ`; the same one-way weakness occurs in `range_coe_geodesicLine_eq_ball_inter_or` at line 404.

summary: The advertised exact classification is formalized only in the forward direction; no theorem shows that every listed Euclidean diameter or orthogonal-circle arc is a Poincaré geodesic.
